# Atomic Leap Ltd

> Experimental Engineering Sandbox & Product R&D Lab based in London, UK. Atomic Leap researches, benchmarks, and validates hard infrastructure problems and commercializes the validated survivors.

## Core Philosophy
Atomic Leap specializes in sovereign software architecture: absolute infrastructure control, zero vendor lock-in, portable self-hosted elements, and complete data sovereignty.

## Primary Pages
- [/](https://atomicleap.com/): Sovereign sandbox overview, active ventures, core research pipelines, and foundational manifesto.
- [/technologies](https://atomicleap.com/technologies): Systems validated, engineering stack, and architectural pillars (Distributed Systems, Ledger Engineering, Production AI, Cloud FinOps, Real-Time Media).
- [Full Specification](https://atomicleap.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive markdown codex including detailed architectural case studies, full technology stack teardown, and operational blueprints.

## Active Ventures & Products
- [BearAudit](https://bearaudit.com): Local-first SEO and site-auditing application where crawl data stays on your machine and AI integrations are optional.

## Key Technical Pillars
- **Distributed Systems:** High-throughput backend services in Go, Node.js, and Python with PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kafka/RabbitMQ.
- **Financial Ledgers:** Double-entry ledger systems, Faster Payments integration, and high-frequency transaction processing.
- **AI & Vector Search:** Production RAG pipelines, fine-tuned LLMs, embedding search, and automated evaluation frameworks.
- **Cloud Infrastructure & FinOps:** AWS CDK, Terraform, Kubernetes, serverless container orchestration, and FinOps cost optimization.
- **Real-Time Streaming:** Low-latency HLS, RTMP, SRT video processing pipelines and TV syndication feeds.
